historicalReview.note: The raised stepped platform is documented. Mountains are one interpretation of the gods' association and possible homes. Replace the draft's definite reference to a homeland left behind with the qualified interpretation while preserving the contrast of height and meaning.

The Lachish conquest reliefs were part of an Assyrian palace display. Pair that example with a clearly original route diagram. Do not present the diagram as a measured throne-room itinerary or reconstructed visitor reaction.
The funerary stepped form and solar association of an obelisk have separate evidence. Keep the architectural meaning without attributing every pyramid or obelisk to a single uniform purpose.

The Karnak project documents a taller central aisle, lower column rows and upper window grilles in the formerly roofed hall. Keep ancient lighting separate from today's exposed ruin and the representation inside the game.
